1.name: Imix
1.description: The primal source of life. Imix represents the beginning, the chaotic potential from which all forms emerge.

2.name: Ik
2.description: The breath of spirit that moves through all things. Ik is communication, inspiration, and the wind that spreads seeds.

3.name: Akbal
3.description: The sanctuary of the self. Akbal is the darkness of the womb, the place where dreams are born and abundance resides.

4.name: Kan
4.description: The potential for growth. Kan represents the seed planted in fertile ground, ready to burst forth with intention.

5.name: Chicchan
5.description: The vitality of the body. Chicchan is the kundalini energy, the wisdom of the body, and the instinct for survival.

1.name: Magnetic
1.description: The point of origin. Magnetic energy attracts all that is needed to fulfill the purpose.

7.name: Resonant
7.description: The tuning fork. Resonant energy aligns the self with higher vibrations to channel inspiration.

13.name: Cosmic
13.description: The completion of the cycle. Cosmic energy represents presence, endurance, and the return to source.
